DUNCAN_NIGHT_REPORT_R01
CYCLE_ID = DNR01-20260830-006
SOURCE_WINDOW = 2026-08-30 / fresh cycle after Fortress R01 merge and DNR01-20260830-005
MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED = b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1
DAY_EVENTS_REVIEWED = issue:204 restore law; issue:206 Night School contract + terminal evidence; issue:198 Tier-1 silhouette law; issue:199 character drawing/texture law; issue:202 pixel-vs-latent-geometry boundary; PR:111 prior DNR01 reports through comment 5465582440; Permanent Archive V1 fresh head fda49c30d09d96b8b7a665fa59fb167325b33035; current empty rebuildable DUNCAN_CONTEXT_NEXT observed before this report
ANIME_TOPICS_STUDIED = black/white design; negative-space grouping; value-mass readability; preservation of meaningful internal voids during controlled cleanup
OPEN_SOURCE_CODE_INSPECTED = OpenCV runtime 4.13.0; upstream opencv/opencv 4.x ref 755546643a671420fae0c20ec5d4cd24a228da8e; Apache-2.0; active upstream commit dated 2026-08-29; modules/imgproc/src/connectedcomponents.cpp CCStatsOp + connected-component labeling/statistics; modules/imgproc/test/test_connectedcomponents.cpp regression/stat tests; modules/imgproc/src/morph.dispatch.cpp getStructuringElement/createMorphologyFilter/morphology path; APIs used: cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats, cv2.getStructuringElement, cv2.morphologyEx; integration cost = zero new framework, disposable exercise only
REFERENCE_PRINCIPLES = Bleach/Hokusai-compatible transferable principle only: strong black/white design depends on intentional empty shapes and readable mass rhythm, not detail accumulation; ZORR application remains original and is not a style-cloning target; issue #198 requires silhouette identity, issue #199 requires BIG SHAPE before detail, and this cycle extends that reasoning to negative-space preservation
EXERCISES = Synthetic Layout A: black graphic mass with two meaningful internal negative-space components plus micro-noise holes; Synthetic Layout B: changed/unseen polygonal mass with four meaningful internal negative-space components plus micro-noise holes. Applied OpenCV MORPH_CLOSE with 5x5 ellipse as controlled cleanup and 61x61 ellipse as deliberate over-clean failure. Meaningful internal negative space = connected white component not touching image border and area >=500 px. Measured count, area mask IoU, area ratio, and normalized centroid drift.
VERIFICATION = Layout A controlled: meaningful components 2->2, negative-space IoU=0.999297, area ratio=0.999297, mean normalized centroid shift=0.00000986. Layout B unseen controlled: 4->4, IoU=0.999149, area ratio=0.999149, mean normalized centroid shift=0.00000360. This supports preservation of major empty shapes while removing only tiny holes/noise.
FAILURES = Layout A aggressive 61x61 close: meaningful components 2->1, negative-space IoU=0.706246, area ratio=0.706246, centroid-shift signal=0.136085. Layout B aggressive: components stayed 4 but meaningful negative-space area collapsed to ratio=0.657795 and IoU=0.657795. Therefore component count alone is insufficient; area/overlap must also be checked.
ROOT_CAUSES = Over-cleaning treats white voids as disposable holes in a black mass. A large morphology kernel closes semantically useful openings along with noise. The failure is scale selection, not an OpenCV defect. Visual simplification without measuring negative-space structure can preserve outer silhouette while destroying interior graphic identity.
REGRESSION_RESULTS = Prior line-economy lesson replayed on an asymmetric synthetic silhouette with OpenCV approxPolyDP: epsilon=0.0025*perimeter reduced contour 1345->20 vertices while silhouette IoU remained 0.998063; aggressive epsilon=0.02 reduced to 15 vertices and lowered IoU to 0.942456. Previous lesson remains directionally valid: simplification is accepted only while identity-bearing structure survives.
TRANSFER_TEST = Changed/unseen Layout B was not used to tune Layout A. The same 5x5 cleanup preserved all four major negative spaces with IoU 0.999149; the deliberately aggressive 61x61 variant collapsed their total area to 65.78%. Transfer supports a general QC method candidate, not a universal kernel-size threshold.
SKILL_DELTA =
- negative_space_grouping_qc: UNTESTED -> PARTIAL
SELF_MODEL_DELTA =
- MEASURE_EMPTY_SPACE_AS_STRUCTURE = When black/white readability matters, evaluate meaningful negative spaces as explicit connected shapes with count, area and position instead of judging only outer contour or foreground detail.
- CLEANUP_CONFIDENCE_RULE = Do not generalize a cleanup scale from one image; require changed/unseen transfer and reject methods that preserve silhouette while materially collapsing interior negative-space structure.
OWNER_TASTE_SIGNALS = issue #198 durable law confirms silhouette-first identity and structural breaks before internal detail; issue #199 durable law confirms BIG SHAPE -> SILHOUETTE -> PRIMARY CONTOUR and MACRO > MESO > MICRO; no new OWNER preference is inferred from this cycle alone
OWNER_TASTE_MODEL_DELTA =
- STRUCTURAL_NEGATIVE_SPACE = CONFIRMED_SUPPORTING_SIGNAL: existing OWNER laws favor macro readability and structural identity; meaningful negative space should be protected when it carries those structures, but this cycle does not elevate a new OWNER lock.
ZORR_APPLICATION = Add negative-space preservation as a candidate QC dimension for Tier-1 black-fill/model-sheet simplification: compare major interior/background void count + area overlap + centroid movement alongside silhouette QC. Pixel-domain QC remains legal only for projected appearance; per issue #202 it must not be used to invent hidden character physics.
PRIME_CORE_CHANGED = NO
PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO
NEXT_TARGETS = First real Tier-1 black-fill transfer using an approved reference without mutating production; test whether meaningful negative-space metrics correlate with human identity readability. Then inspect Krita/OpenToonz ready-made black/white/value-group workflows before any custom ZORR tooling.
